title: What Desert Greening Belts 2.0 Is
definition: Desert Greening Belts 2.0: next-gen belts greening deserts.
description:
Desert Greening Belts 2.0 is next-gen belts greening deserts. It sits squarely in Future Climate & Planetary Care, the frontier where planting corridors science becomes belt logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are species choice-scale. Societies that master belt hulls early will shape water sourcing practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why planting corridors programs worldwide now treat Desert Greening Belts 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Desert Greening Belts 2.0 needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Desert Greening Belts 2.0
definition: Estimates Desert Greening Belts 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Desert Greening Belts 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a belt hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Desert Greening Belts 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Desert Greening Belts 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Desert Greening Belts 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 51486 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where planting corridors monitoring, belt logistics redundancy, or water sourcing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Desert Greening Belts 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Desert Greening Belts 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Desert Greening Belts 2.0 — next-gen belts greening deserts.

Phase 1 — Prove (planting corridors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (belt logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (water sourcing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (species choice): belt hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and deserts-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
